Tech Report: L'ennesimo tormentone del calciomercato: Varela può già valere 40 milioni dopo 10 partite in Italia? Da Piatek a Iturbe, quando il mercato scambia una stagione per una carriera

📅 19 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (653 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Tuttomercatoweb

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Nove gol in dieci partite giocate sono certamente un dato.
  • Ma può, dopo undici partite, avere già una valutazione da 35 o 40 milioni di euro?
  • Per capire il possibile prezzo di Varela bisogna separare due cose: le qualità individuali del centravanti e quelle che il gioco di Juric può amplificare.

Nove gol in dieci partite giocate sono certamente un dato. Gustavo Varela è senza ombra di dubbio un giocatore che sta straordinariamente stupendo al suo anno di debutto in Serie A. Ma è tutto 'vero'? E' tutto oro quel che luccica? C'è un assunto da cui partire: il Monza ha trovato il giocatore perfetto per il proprio allenatore, Ivan Juric. E questo è certamente un colpo non da poco, perché la società brianzola, pur nelle mille difficoltà, invischiata nella lotta per non retrocedere, è stata capace di individuare un ragazzo poco noto e conosciuto e capire che le sue qualità e doti erano funzionali per il tecnico. Un po' quello che dovrebbe essere l'obiettivo primario e principale per ogni direttore sportivo.

Ma può, dopo undici partite, avere già una valutazione da 35 o 40 milioni di euro? Il problema non è che Varela valga o non valga 40 milioni. Il problema è che, dopo così poche gare, qualcuno potrebbe essere chiamato a pagare oggi il calciatore che forse diventerà domani. E lo scotto in molti l'hanno già pagato, abbagliati dal clamore mediatico, da quel che appare, viene percepito, ma in fondo non è davvero. Krzysztof Piatek fece 13 gol in 17 partite in Serie A col Genoa, il Milan spese per lui 38 milioni di euro ma venne di lì a non molto ceduto all'Herta Berlino, nonostante 9 reti nei primi sei mesi. Una grande fiammata per un'illusione (straordinaria) collettiva che non ebbe però seguito e continuità. E figuriamoci Juan Manuel Iturbe, che Walter Sabatini strappò alla Juventus: lo prese la Roma, dopo 8 gol in 33 partite con l'Hellas Verona. Segnò poco, giocò male, l'illusione lì fu quella di aver trovato il nuovo genio del calcio italiano. E anche Patrik Schick, che poi in Germania s'è riconfermato grande al Bayer Leverkusen. Lo prese la Roma, dopo un inizio meraviglioso con la Sampdoria. Lì sì che il talento è vero e con continuità, la Roma non seppe individuarne però la funzionalità (al netto di infortuni e adattamento). Altri esempi? Jackson Martinez, strapagato dall'Atletico Madrid dopo le stagioni al Porto. Andy Carroll, fece 11 reti in 18 gare da titolare in Premier League e al Liverpool lo ricordano più per il codino che per i milioni spesi. Timo Werner, 28 reti in Bundesliga, è arrivato il nuovo panzer, macché, il Chelsea spese una fortuna e mai s'è ripetuto. E poi via, da Renato Sanches a Wilfried Bony, quanti sogni spezzati e milioni gonfiati dall'illusione e dall'entusiasmo.

Per capire il possibile prezzo di Varela bisogna separare due cose: le qualità individuali del centravanti e quelle che il gioco di Juric può amplificare. E' il vecchio assunto e teorema del 'con Gian Piero Gasperini all'Atalanta tanti facevano bene e altrove no'. Sapete qual era il segreto? Le scelte della famiglia Percassi e delle dirigenze. La parola 'funzionalità'. Creare un vestito adatto al proprio allenatore, i giocatori giusti al netto di nomi e risonanza mediatica. Varela è un finalizzatore superiore alla media? Oppure sta vivendo un periodo di conversione straordinario? Riuscirebbe a produrre le stesse occasioni in una squadra di vertice? Una major spesso affronta avversari chiusi, che concedono meno profondità. Altra tematica: può fare reparto da solo? Un conto è essere devastante quando il sistema crea spazi e accompagna l'attacco; un altro è diventare il riferimento di una squadra che deve costruire contro una difesa schierata.

Il Monza potrebbe avere trovato in Varela il centravanti ideale per il calcio di Ivan Juric. Ma una cosa è essere il terminale offensivo perfetto di un sistema che esalta verticalità, aggressività e transizioni; un'altra è dimostrare di poter essere il centravanti di una grande squadra, chiamata spesso a scardinare difese schierate. Il mercato rischia di pagare oggi entrambe le versioni, senza sapere ancora quale delle due abbia davvero davanti. In una moda mica solo italiana, beninteso, ma nella quale ci tuffiamo sempre a caso fitto...

Egypt sack their manager for 'negative impact on team image' after he fainted when fight broke out between his TWO wives with punches and hair-pulling in a bar

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 13:16 EST, 13 November 2026 | Updated: 13:48 EST, 13 November 2026.
  • Egypt will begin their African Cup of Nations (AFCON) qualifying matches with a new manager after their previous head coach was sacked amid a torrid breakdown of both of his marriages.
  • Hossam Hassan was handed his marching orders on Saturday after an incident in August which saw his two wives embroiled in a vicious fight, captured and shared on social media.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TAMARA PRENN, SENIOR SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 13:16 EST, 13 November 2026 | Updated: 13:48 EST, 13 November 2026.

Egypt will begin their African Cup of Nations (AFCON) qualifying matches with a new manager after their previous head coach was sacked amid a torrid breakdown of both of his marriages.

Hossam Hassan was handed his marching orders on Saturday after an incident in August which saw his two wives embroiled in a vicious fight, captured and shared on social media.

Hassan's first wife Howaida El-Gharbawy and his second Dina 'Dan Adam' Mustafa started the argument while at a hotel bar in the upscale Porto Marina resort on Egypt's north coast.

El-Gharbawy and Mustafa were videoed arguing with Hassan in the middle attempting to cool tensions, but the duo came to blows, with punches thrown and hair pulled as screams filled the air.

Such was the stress of the incident that Hassan is believed to have fainted as he tried to separate the two women.

Horrified public onlookers watched as the physical fight grew with relatives of the trio getting involved, and security was called before Hassan was taken to hospital.

Industry observers note that en Égypte, un violent différend a éclaté entre... les deux femmes du sélectionneur égyptien, Hossam Hassan. 🇪🇬😳Le conflit a dégénéré en échauffourée avec coups et tirage de cheveux, avant que des jeunes et des passages n'interviennent dans la bagarre. pic.twitter.com/pvRUSMtAsD.

Egypt head coach Hossam Hassan was sacked this week after a fight broke out between his two wives.

Hassan's first wife Howaida El-Gharbawy and his second Dina 'Dan Adam' Mustafa started the argument while at a hotel in the upscale Porto Marina resort.

The 60-year-old is believed to have fainted while trying to separate the two women.

Both women are believed to have been left with cuts and bruises following the vicious scrap, while Hassan, despite briefly losing consciousness, was left unharmed.

His lawyers later told Sky News Arabia, via the Sun, that he was not suffering a health crisis during the incident, and that he remained in good health.

But in the days that followed, Hassan started proceedings to divorce El-Gharbawy, who he has been married to for decades. The couple also share three children.

The 60-year-old has a further two children with second wife Mustafa, who Le Parisien alleges also filed for divorce in the days after the footage went viral on social media.

The Egyptian Football Association ensured that Hassan's professional life took a similar nosedive, sharing in a statement that his dismissal was due in part to reputational damage the scandal might be doing to the national team.

'After analysing all the circumstances and events of the past few days, as well as their consequences and the negative impact they have had on the positive image and stability of our national team, the Board of Directors has decided, within the framework of its responsibilities, to dismiss coach Hossam Hassan and his entire technical staff and to end his tenure,' their statement read.

Mustafa's lawyer Mohamed Shams gave an interview on Sky News Arabia claiming that his client had been the victim of a 'premeditated attack'.

'We hoped it wouldn't come to divorce, but things escalated to this level.'.

Hassan married his second wife in 2015, with Egyptian law allowing Muslim men to marry up to four women, providing that any wives have been formally informed that another marriage is to take place.

The law mandates that the husband is also obligated to treat all of his wives equally with regard to housing, financial support and standard of living.

Hassan had been married to his first wife El-Gharbawy for decades, with the pair sharing three of his five children.

Hassan and Mustafa briefly separated four years ago before recoupling before the spat that ended both of his marriages.

As well as being relieved of his duties, Hassan was also sanctioned by the Supreme Council for Media Regulation, leaving him unable to publicly address the media following his sacking.

Mohamed Salah and Co will now play their first qualifier of the international break against Malawi under fresh head coach Ali Maher.

The former Liverpool star could be among those Pharaohs stars privately pleased with the departure of Hassan, after he was benched by his ex-manager for the last two international clashes.

When asked why the superstar and national team captain had been left on the sidelines for the ties, Hassan had stated: 'It is not right for a country of 120 million people for the national team to depend on one player.'.

Giuseppe Cuomo, difensore del Vicenza, è stato ospite di "È solo calcio". Queste le sue parole riportate da trivenetogoal.it: "Abbiamo vissuto questi giorni per stringerci ancora di più e cercare di risolvere qualche problema che possiamo avere in campo. A livello mentale ci è servito per andare ancora più forte, credo che in questo momento bisogna dare di più perché quello che stiamo facendo non basta. La maglia viene sempre sudata e stiamo cercando di dare il massimo, siamo dei ragazzi che a livello umano pochi gruppi hanno dei ragazzi così bravi. Difesa a tre o a quattro? Ho giocato con entrambe quindi mi trovo bene uguale. A Sudtirol e Crotone con Golemic ho giocato da centrale. A livello fisico stiamo benissimo non penso sia dovuto quello il calo nei secondi tempi. Non è neanche un problema tattico perché il mister è sempre stato la nostra forza, ce lo ripete ogni giorno che lui crede in noi. Forse è più una questione mentale che in questo momento stai subendo il perdere le partite di fila. I giocatori forti in questa momento devono farsi valere e cambiare rotta in un modo o nell’altro. Il salto di categoria è diverso trovi gente che ti punta ogni volta quindi è più dura. Però l’uno contro uno è quello che mi piace. Quando senti le voci di un possibile cambio di allenatore la vivi male, perché noi che siamo qui già dall’anno scorso abbiamo fatto una grande vittoria del campionato e conosciamo la persona, è normale che ci dispiaccia. E’ una soluzione che non avrei mai voluto. Sentiamo una responsabilità forte nei suoi confronti, obiettivamente è il nostro leader. Dobbiamo fare sicuramente molto di più per stare tutti sereni.

Io penso che la squadra è molto forte poi sappiamo che nel calcio si devono incastrare tante cose. Credo nella salvezza tranquillamente, mi aspettavo qualche punto in più ad inizio campionato. La Serie B è un campionato difficile, sicuramente avremmo perso qualche partita. La verità è che siamo abituati bene da un paio di stagioni che vinciamo sempre. La fortuna è che ci sono tante squadre lì, per uscirne dobbiamo alzare la testa, spalle larghe ed essere positivo perché con una vittoria non sei più in fondo alla classifica. Io so il gruppo, so che squadra c’è, la società che c’è e i tifosi. Tutti questi tifosi ci responsabilizzano in campo a fare qualcosa in più".

Dopo aver respinto gli assalti estivi di Brentford, Parma e Fiorentina su richiesta di Gattuso, la dirigenza biancoceleste valuta il prolungamento oltre il 2027.

According to recent reports, il futuro di Matteo Cancellieri alla Lazio continua ad attirare l'attenzione in vista dei prossimi mesi. Secondo quanto riportato da TuttoMercatoWeb, il club deve riflettere con attenzione sul contratto dell'esterno italiano, visto che l'accordo attuale scadrà il prossimo 30 giugno 2027.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

It has been revealed that nel corso dell'ultima sessione di mercato estiva, diversi club avevano provato a sondare il terreno per assicurarsi il giocatore. Dall'estero si era fatto avanti il Brentford dalla Premier League, mentre in Serie A avevano preso informazioni prima il Parma e poi la Fiorentina, specialmente dopo l'approdo nella Capitale di Albert Gudmundsson. Tuttavia, a bloccare ogni possibile partenza è stato lo stesso allenatore Gennaro Gattuso, fermamente intenzionato a non ridurre ulteriormente le opzioni a sua disposizione nel reparto offensivo.

Il tecnico punta forte su di lui anche per gennaio. Nonostante qualche guaio fisico, Cancellieri ha trovato spazio ed è stabilmente nelle rotazioni, alternandosi con un Isaksen in grande forma. Ora tocca al presidente Claudio Lotito e alla dirigenza decidere se avviare le trattative per il rinnovo.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Gianni Rivera, leggenda del Milan, è stato intervistato da MilanCommunityTV dal giornalista Luca Serafini a margine della presentazione del suo libro: "Nessuno ha pensato mai di coinvolgermi veramente nel mondo del calcio, nella Federazione, e via dicendo, e quindi sono un po' così distratto da questa condizione".

Il Milan ogni tanto ti capita di vederlo?

"Beh, mi capita quando c'è qualche partita in televisione e che io sono in casa la vedo, anche se non è il Milan".

Come vede il duello per la FIGC?

"Io non so chi è che determina questa condizione. Bisognerebbe capire bene chi elegge il presidente, come lo elegge e perché lo elegge, e poi nessuno di noi sa quali sono i sistemi e allora qualche volta capita qualcuno che il calcio non lo conosce per niente".

Che cosa è rimasto dei tuoi tempi in questo calcio?

"La lunghezza e la larghezza del campo. Ma io adesso devo essere sincero, non seguo moltissimo il calcio perché, chiudendo i rapporti col Milan per ragioni anche di tribunali, non mi interessa più, ora meno di prima".

Che emozioni ti suscita rivedere i tuoi grandi momenti grazie al libro?

"Mi fa piacere anche perché vengo accettato intanto per quello che ero ai miei tempi e poi per come sono anche oggi e quindi lo vedo sempre quando un club organizza una manifestazione per vendere anche i miei libri e, insomma, vuol dire che non sono cambiate molto le condizioni e il rapporto fra me e i tifosi".

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

At the final whistle, the first song the stadium DJ played was Spirit of the Blues and how those relieved Evertonians lapped it up after a week of angst.

Industry observers note that their team had been on the precipice of a defeat that would have exacerbated all the frustrations that bubbled away following the chaotic conclusion to the transfer window. Indeed, it was 10 seconds over the allotted five minutes of added time when the ball fell to Ainsley Maitland-Niles.

It had been three years since the former Arsenal full-back had played in the Premier League – his last goal in England was on October 30, 2019, in an EFL Cup tie with Liverpool at Anfield that ended 5-5 – and he would not have joined Everton if their attempt to sign Kenny Tete from Fulham had not failed.

Recent findings suggest that but here he was 30 yards from goal, with no need to break his stride as Manchester United’s backtracking defenders presented him with an invitation to shoot. So that’s what he did. With one perfectly timed swish of his right foot, an unlikely hero transformed the mood of a club.

It has been revealed that "That is something SPECIAL!"Ainsley Maitland-Niles earns a draw for Everton on his debut with an unbelievable 96th minute strike! 🤯 pic.twitter.com/HNdx9PxrUP.

“Brilliant technique,” mentioned David Moyes, Everton’s manager, who had only introduced Maitland-Niles in the 77th minute after James Garner had succumbed to cramp and could run no more. “We are still getting to know Ainsley but that was a brilliant goal.”.

Recent findings suggest that only those with the coldest hearts would begrudge Everton this point, which was especially hard-earned given they had conceded an 88th-minute header to Benjamin Sesko. But there is no chance a disbelieving Michael Carrick will feel that way.

Benajmin Sesko puts Manchester United back in front! 👊 pic.twitter.com/MF3A9LyaY8.

Sources indicate that united should, really, have won this game comfortably. Everton were there to be exploited and when Bryan Mbuemo put them ahead early in the second half, they should have powered away into the distance. Everton’s effort was good but they were in danger of losing hope.

Yet, incredibly, United gave Everton two helping hands. They had not been in a position to assist last Tuesday evening, when phone calls from Merseyside to Old Trafford to take Joshua Zirkzee on loan were met with rejection. But the second half display more than made up for that.

“We’re bitterly disappointed,” said Carrick, who was one step removed from having steam puffing from his ears. “All the work that went into putting us in that position at different stages to then come away like that… it’s not a great feeling. It feels like a defeat. It’s a bit of a cliché to say.”.

But clichés are true. First United were passive when Tyrique George crashed in a brilliant right-footed drive in the 83rd minute and then, after Sesko profited from Jordan Pickford’s weak hands, they were passive again in allowing Everton to build the move that ended up with Maitland-Niles’ howitzer.

It has been revealed that how had it come to this? It was beautiful bedlam, the kind of joy that only football delivers, but for long periods it felt like it was an opportunity for United. There was anticipation that Everton’s fans would create a furnace but there was also the fear it would be dispiritingly quiet.

Had this fixture been at Goodison Park, with its steep stands, tight confines and acoustics that split your ears, United would have been aware of the siege mentality as soon as their bus rolled up outside the stadium but their new sparkling home is rather more hospitable.

This is no criticism of the home crowd – it is anything but. Why should it always fall to them to bail out the failings of those in charge when those in charge, specifically the executives and recruitment department, have given them scant reason to have hope?

The route to victory for United, then, was relatively straightforward: for all Everton’s initial huff and puff, it always appeared that it would be a case of the away team repeating the simple things, retaining their concentration and waiting for a breakthrough.

Sources indicate that it could have come as early as the eighth minute. Luke Shaw’s deep cross to the back post picked out Mbuemo, whose cushioned header invited Bruno Fernandes to take aim but the Portuguese’s volley clipped the crossbar with Pickford stranded.

Recent findings suggest that united dominated and Marcus Rashford was central to it all, a scampering presence down the left who gave Merlin Röhl, playing as an auxiliary right-back, all kinds of problems. The only thing missing from his opening 45 minutes was a goal.

Recent findings suggest that when Mbuemo scored so early after the break, it felt as if this was going to be one puncture too many for Everton to withstand and the anticipation was United would get the job done. In all fairness to Moyes, however, he was not in the mood to accept excuses.

His substitutions were all positive, with Jack Grealish changing the mood and Hayden Hackney providing dynamism. But it was the former Middlesbrough man who drove forward to give George, whose loan move from Chelsea was made permanent in June, the opportunity to smash an 83rd-minute bullet past Senne Lammens.

"That was unanswerable!"What a way for Tyrique George to open his account for Everton! 🔵 pic.twitter.com/c0HPRjWUia.

According to recent reports, “I told the players there would be no excuses and the players all agreed,” Moyes said. “They have hugely bought into it. And, you know, sometimes when you have [fewer] players it means everybody has to be ready. Sometimes when you have a small squad you have to find a way of making it work.”.

They did just that. Pickford should have saved the header from Sesko that looked as though it had given United the lift, but Everton, with their manager belligerent and their fans sensing all was not lost, had other ideas. The noise they generated as Maitland-Niles’s goal went in was unique to this stadium.

In a recent development, as Moyes celebrated, shaking his fists and revelling in the positive turn of events, Carrick put his hand across his face and shook his head repeatedly. All the while, Everton’s fans sang I guess that’s why they call it the Blues. United’s head coach certainly had them. Everton, simply, had relief.

Sources indicate that 2 - For just the second time in the last 50 years, Manchester United have conceded 2+ goals in each of their first three games of a league season, along with 2020-21.Leaky. pic.twitter.com/B2Dk6Ioxkq.

It felt like a win. The crowd was with us, we fight to the end and that’s how you get that type of result.

According to recent reports, it’s amazing. Everyone wants to start like that and fortunately I did. I put my foot through it and it ended up in the top corner which I’m happy about.

I came here to work hard. It’s a team full of hard workers and I fit right in. I’m going to show I can pull my weight and give as much as everyone else, if not a little bit more.

Even I have a lump in my throat to see him do that after his original move to Everton in August 2021 was stymied by a late change of heart by Mikel Arteta. Don’t normally approve of badge kissers but he has waited such a long time for that and must have thought his chance had gone.

Sources indicate that just time to kick off before the whistle goes. Probably a fair result and that goal from Maitland-Niles was good enough to win a game never mind save it.

Sources indicate that everton 2 Manchester United 2 (Maitland-Niles) Stunning strike! Mazraoui had tackled Dewsbury-Hall in the box after more good work between Grealish and Hackney down the left. But the tackle diverted the ball to Maitland-Niles 25 yards out. And he wrapped his instep around a shot on debut that bent into the top left corner. What a goal!

Sources indicate that "That is something SPECIAL!"Ainsley Maitland-Niles earns a draw for Everton on his debut with an unbelievable 96th minute strike! 🤯 pic.twitter.com/HNdx9PxrUP.

Recent findings suggest that grealish’s beguiling feet dazzle Mazraoui down the Everton left as he tricks him to reach the byline. He cuts back a pass to Barry who tees up Hackney for a shot that he wafts miles over the bar. Grealish gives him a look as if to say, “Really?”.

George finds himself in a near identical spot from which he scored and tries again with a thumping shot that flies into the side-netting via Lammens’ finger tips. He was offside on this occasion, though.

Five minutes of added time for Everton to level again.

Everton 1 Manchester United 2 (Sesko) Sesko wins the ball in the middle and works it out to Bruno Fernandes running down the left. He stops, faces up Maitland-Niles and waits for Shaw to gallop past him before rolling it into the left-back’s stride. Shaw fizzes over a cross that parts Tarkowski’s luxuriant barnet and Sesko, lurking on his shoulder, buries it from eight yards.

Benajmin Sesko puts Manchester United back in front! 👊 pic.twitter.com/MF3A9LyaY8.

As Dominic indicates, below, Manchester United have been asking for this. They have been toothless since Mbeumo’s goal and the only significant threat, Rashford, was taken off for a left-back.

It has been revealed that everton 1 Man Utd 1 (George) A rasping, rising shot that beats Lammens at his near post. He absolutely larruped it after good work by Hackney to put him in space down the right of the box.

Industry observers note that "That was unanswerable!"What a way for Tyrique George to open his account for Everton! 🔵 pic.twitter.com/c0HPRjWUia.

It has been revealed that if you largely try and defend a 1-0 lead and don’t go for that second goal, there’s always the danger of that happening. Superb finish from George to equalise but it’s been so passive from United. Asking for trouble and they’ve got it. Significant 7 minutes plus injury time for them now.

Free-kick on the left, parallel with the penalty spot. Hackney bends it in with his right and Branthwaite heads it on target but too close to Lammens who oddly elects to punch.

Mykolenko gives the ball back from the throw-in as Fernandes serves his minute on the sidelines.

Dalot is booked for pulling Grealish’s shirt when the left winger had spun him.

Garner almost immediately goes down and starts stretching his calves.

Recent findings suggest that george has switched to the right to accommodate Grealish. I wonder if there was ever a possibility of him returning to Villa? Would Unai Emery treasure him?

“He’s back!” the stadium announcer has proclaimed, as Jack Grealish has entered the fray. The move has provided an immediate bounce but let’s see what the former England man can do to change the pattern of the game. Everton believe they have got a £100m player. It’s time to show it.

Grealish’s first contribution sends Mykolenko away on an overlap and Martinez messes up his clearance from the cross, shanking it behind for a corner that they defend soundly.

Manchester United corner on the left after Tielemans’ 25-yard shot was deflected behind. Fernandes plays it along the ground to Shaw in the D. The left-back’s control spoons the ball up with his left so he improvises a right-foot volley with his swinger, dragging it predictably wide.

Rohl is beaten yet again by Rashford and works his way into the book after pulling him back. It’s been hard going for the Everton right back against Rashford but United just haven’t taken advantage of it enough.

Jack Grealish is stripped and ready to come on.

Rashford jinks at pace 35 yards up the inside-left channel, chopping to the left and barrelling between defenders. He takes it too wide to shoot so cutely backheels to Cunha who pulls back his left foot to shoot from six yards but Tarkowski slides his leg through his gait and pokes the ball away. The away fans shout for a penalty but Cunha has no complaints.

Barry diddles Martinez by feinting to the right and then darting left to open a rout to goal. He hammers a shot from about 16 yards that Shaw slides across to block, diverting it to Dewsbury-Hall whose follow-up effort is a tame daisycutter that Lammens easily gathers.

It threatened to be the case that a Manchester United goal would puncture the atmosphere completely and so it has proven. The likelihood here is the away team will score again in the next 10 minutes to completely kill the game. Everton have endured a miserable week and this flat performance is entirely in keeping with the narrative.

Johnson cuts in off the right to run on to Garner’s pass and shoots from 18 yards. Martinez makes himself as big as possible and the shot clips his calf, sending it up before it dips threateningly, whistling over the bar.

According to recent reports, mbeumo heads out Garner’s corner. Dewsbury-Hall crosses it back into the box and Tarkowski tries to head it across into the middle. Manchester United clear their lines.

Shaw slides in to block Dewsbury-Hall’s shot after the attacking midfielder had manipulated an opportunity with a quick interchange with Johnson.

Key for Manchester United, who have taken the lead in a match for the first time this season, not to let up on the tempo with which they started this half.

Can’t be long before Grealish comes on.

Everton respond with a menacing cross in from the left, from George, I think, that eludes Johnson as he arrives in the middle a second late.

Everton 0 Manchester United 1 (Mbeumo) United were probing patiently from the kick-off, Mainoo the hub until he helped the ball down the right and Mbeumo drove in from the right touchline, splitting George and Mykolenko until he reached the 18-yard line and wrapped his left instep around a shot that he arrowed into the bottom left corner.

Rashford has been United’s most threatening outlet and has the beating of Rohl but Mbeumo and Cunha were poor in those opening 45 minutes and both guilty of turning over the ball cheaply when United were breaking late in the first period. Barry should have hit the target with a header from Rohl’s cross. But it’s been a lacklustre game, low in quality so far.

In a recent development, A drab match that came to life in the last few minutes of the half, creating good a good chance for Thierno Barry and Jarrad Branthwaite thwarting Marcus Rashford and Bruno Fernandes. Everton look wide open on the right side of their defence and Brennan Johnson is starting to make headway against Luke Shaw.

Brilliant sliding tackle from Branthwaite when Rashford, piling down the inside-left channel in full flight. Just as he was about to pull the trigger, Branthwaite rolled out himself to knock it away and leapt back to his feet to block Fernandes’ stinging follow-up with the his head.

Mykolenko’s long throw from the left raises the Man Utd blood pressure as they try to scramble it clear. The ball pinballs around the six-yard box, comes off Dalot last and straight to Branthwaite who catches it straight and true but clips the shot at Lammens.

There will be three additional minutes. Barry and Johnson link up again to send the rangey striker down the right but again he hits his cross/shot straight at a defender at close quarters. He can’t work an angle but tries to go through a defender.

Recent findings suggest that rohl and Barry link up in more orthodox fashion with an excellent, dipping cross from the right-back. Barry peels off Maguire and thumps his header wide. That’s the best chance of the game.

Neat one-two between Johnson and Barry sends the latter into the box on the right but his shot/cross is fired straight at Shaw. The crowd shouts ‘Hand ball!’ but it wasn’t and the ref waves play on.

Recent findings suggest that everton have had no spark at all so far. George goes down when challenged by Mbeumo to give them a free-kick on the left, 35 yards from goal. Garner hits a floaty cross to the right of the box and Barry heads it wide.

It was Johnson who was under scrutiny for a ‘foul’ on Martinez’ but it was just a hand on the back.

Branthwaite is winded when he collides with Pickford in midair defending a back-post cross. Seems to be OK.

Fernandes whips over a cross and Armstrong beats Martínez to head it clear. VAR is looking at Martínez’s claim that he was fouled. Now it’s been cleared.

Yellow card for Johnson for sliding into Cunha’s stride and raising his right boot to leg him up right by the byline on the left, 12 inches outside the area.

Good afternoon and welcome to live coverage of Everton vs Manchester United from Hill Dickinson Stadium. The hosts have made a creditable start on the field but four points from their opening two games cannot gloss over the discontent fostered by the owners and executives because of the credibility gap between their talk about recruitment and their paltry achievements.

The fact that their comeback against Bournemouth to earn a draw last week was achieved with Beto, Tim Iroegbunum and Iliman Ndiaye on the field and all three have now been sold with only Jack Grealish returning on loan to compensate tells its own story.

Speak to supporters and it is emblematic of ownership, they fear, who are prioritising Roma and view the Hill Dickinson as a terrific multisport and concert venue with a heritage football club attached. The bullishness of Angus Kinnear, the chief executive, rings hollower with each pronouncement and it is little wonder that the fans are so disenchanted.

David Moyes will not walk away but once again he has been sent into the fray against teams with £250m midfields armed with a spud gun. Having stated that, we should not underestimate his capacity to rally the old “dogs of war” spirit even if the crowd is still yearning more for a “school of science” revival.

According to recent reports, manchester United won on their first visit to the Hill Dickinson last season when Benjamin Sesko came off the bench to score the only goal of the game and give Michael Carrick a fifth win in six league games as caretaker manager. They were far more fluid in their forward play during the victory over Ipswich last week but it was against an error-stricken defence and they continued to be as worryingly open at the back as they had been against Hull City in the opening round of fixtures with Luke Shaw and Lisandro Martínez having brain fades.

In a recent development, shaw is a doubt today, along with Mason Mount, while Amad Diallo, Matthijs de Ligt, Carlos Baleba and Manuel Ugarte have all been ruled out. Only Christian Norgaard is absent for Everton but so thin is their squad, they will cast covetous glances at Man Utd’s bench, not least at Joshua Zirkzee who was the subject of a very late rejected bid on deadline day.

By TAMARA PRENN, SENIOR SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 18:28 EST, 12 November 2026 | Updated: 14:42 EST, 13 November 2026.

Bruno Fernandes has rejected a new contract at Manchester United against the turbulent backdrop of the departure of head coach Michael Carrick.

The Manchester United captain publicly questioned the former manager's tactics after his side's Champions League thrashing at the hands of Como, and has struggled to find form this season.

Discussions are believed to have started between Fernandes and Man United over the summer, on the heels of a strong campaign which saw him named Men's PFA Player of the Year.

But after an initial proposal from the club is thought to have been rejected by the midfield talisman, Fernandes has now snubbed a second deal with improved terms, in what could be an early headache for incoming manager Mauricio Pochettino.

The Portuguese international's contract is set to expire in June 2027, which means that if the club and player fail to agree fresh terms, Fernandes will be free to discuss a summer move with clubs abroad as early as the January transfer window.

The club may yet seek to trigger the 12-month extension in Fernandes' contract, but will continue talks over aspects including his salary and the length of his fresh deal as they are keen for him to stay.

Bruno Fernandes has rejected a second set of terms from Manchester United as the club seeks to pin him down to a fresh deal.

The club captain inked his latest terms in 2024 with his contract set to expire next June.

Man United at the moment sit in the relegation zone after a 40-year worst-ever start to the season, and announcing a new deal for Fernandes might have given the club an crucial boost of morale during a difficult international break.

Fernandes was brought back into the fold after going through a brief period of being frozen out of Carrick's squad following his incendiary comments following defeat in Italy last month.

Fernandes, who is usually very deliberate in what he indicates in the media, was scathing in his criticism of coaches after the Como debacle.

'It's a decision from the staff to not press man-to-man and sometimes leave a little space in behind and try to get the ball in the first moment, to wait for them, to give them the ball,' he noted.

'But sometimes when you give too much the ball to these teams they get confident, they have so many bodies behind the ball that make you run a lot, make people get frustrated, and then obviously when you recover the ball the legs are, and the brain, much more difficult to make it work.'.

His post-Como interview was widely condemned by fans and pundits alike, with Gary Neville lamenting: 'If that's your captain saying that, imagine what they're saying in the dressing room behind closed doors when no one's listening. That's horrific.'.

He also told Fernandes to 'read the room' and accused him of being an 'excuse merchant' on his podcast.

Fernandes was left on the bench for Man United's next Premier League appointment, a loss to Bournemouth, before returning to the starting XI against Chelsea the following matchday.

After Man United's comeback win against Roma, Fernandes was defiant in his post-match remarks as he stressed that he had not been sanctioned for undermining Carrick with his initial interview.

Recent findings suggest that 'The club needed that win. The players needed that win. It is something we needed as a group of players and staff,' he stated. 'We have been working so hard to get out of this situation together. It has been tough. There has been a lot of speculation in the media.

Fernandes was publicly critical of his former head coach Michael Carrick last month but was later adamant that he had not held clear-the-air talks with him.

In a recent development, 'A lot of lies around many things that have happened at this club, between me and the manager, like that we have cleared the air. Nothing like that happened.

'The manager took a decision of making myself on the bench because I wasn't performing. And that's fair.

'Everyone felt like that was a punishment for the words that I had [after Como]. And if it was, it was right.

It has been revealed that 'The manager makes the decisions. I have to accept it. I have to go forward with that. It doesn't change the belief I have in the manager, the staff and every player at this club.

'And it doesn't change my aim to win every f***ing game that I have ahead of me.'.

Fernandes' sabre-rattling was ultimately unable to keep Carrick in his job however, with the former club captain finally sacked on Thursday after an agonising three-day wait.

Man United's hierarchy, notably chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox, have come under fire from the fanbase and within the club for their treatment of the departing coach, with Carrick taking two days of training at Carrington as they mulled his sacking.

Wilcox and Berrada jetted to Monaco earlier this week to meet with Ineos chief Sir Jim Ratcliffe and discuss the departure of Carrick, with the club's Glazer ownership ratifying the decision to replace him with United States national team coach Pochettino.

Daily Mail Sport reported on Thursday evening that staff members inside the club have been upset with the protracted sacking, which has been deemed disrespectful of Carrick's status as a club legend.

Il giornalista della Gazzetta dello Sport analizza il momento d'oro dei biancocelesti: dai meriti di Gattuso al confronto con le massive.

Il noto giornalista della Gazzetta dello Sport Mimmo Cugini, intervenuto ai microfoni di TuttoMercatoWeb durante la trasmissione Maracanà, ha analizzato il momento straordinario della Serie A, concentrandosi in particolare sulle ambizioni e sul percorso di crescita della Lazio guidata da Gattuso.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

It has been revealed that se facciamo una valutazione tecnica, nelle seconde scelte c'è un gap con le squadre che lottano per il titolo. Bisogna però valutare come gioca questa Lazio, perché Gattuso è riuscito a far dare ai giocatori tutto ciò che hanno e anche qualcosa in più. L'esempio più lampante è quello di Frattesi, che all'Inter era in un sistema di gioco che non lo valorizzava nonostante i gol pesanti segnati in Champions League. I giocatori della Lazio fanno quello che sanno fare e quindi ad ora viaggiano.

According to recent reports, lo scudetto è una grande scommessa e illusione, ma capisco l'entusiasmo dei tifosi, perché una stagione in cui le altre non danno il cento per cento può capitare. Ad ora non vedo troppe squadre che possono metterla in difficoltà, ma sicuramente capiremo di più quando avrà affrontato Roma, Inter e Como. In questo momento sono sulle ali dell'entusiasmo.

Tra poche ore inizierà il cammino dell’Italia nel Mondiale Under 17 e tra i protagonisti della spedizione azzurra agli ordini del commissario tecnico Franceschini ci sarà anche Federico Croci, centrocampista offensivo classe 2010 che gioca sotto età con la Primavera della Fiorentina ed è tra i talenti più in vista del campionato giovanile.

Sull’avvicinamento all’esperienza per il ragazzo si è espresso il suo scopritore Andrea Ritorni, capo scout della Vigo Global Sport: “Sento Federico tutti i giorni, è in Qatar con i compagni da lunedì e si sta preparando nel migliore dei modi all'appuntamento. Prima di partire ha avuto un virus che ha risolto in pochissimo tempo ed ora sta benissimo sia mentalmente che fisicamente. Tocca a noi farlo rimanere sereno ed allontanare le pressioni che arrivano inevitabilmente da stampa, tifosi, mondo esterno. E continuare a volare bassi portando rispetto sempre a tutti perché bruciarsi a quell'età è facile”, ha detto a Repubblica - Firenze.

Parlando in conferenza stampa da Coverciano all'inizio della sosta di novembre per le nazionali appena conclusa, il ct dell'Italia, Roberto Mancini, aveva speso qualche parola anche per Croci: "È un 2010 e gioca coi 2007, ha qualità importanti. La Fiorentina ha giocatori bravi". Noi di TMW ve lo abbiamo indicato tra i migliori talenti italiani nella Top-100 dei nati tra il 2005 e il 2010.

Jurgen Klopp reveals he confronted Germany star over controversial crown celebration with links to 'anti-LGBTQ+ group' - and promises he won't repeat it

📅 13 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (890 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 12:42 EST, 13 November 2026 | Updated: 15:09 EST, 13 November 2026.
  • Germany manager Jurgen Klopp insists midfielder Felix Nmecha will not repeat a controversial goal celebration after opposition from supporters.
  • Nmecha, a Christian player for Borussia Dortmund, was criticised last weekend for celebrating scoring by lowering an imaginary crown from his head onto the pitch.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Published: 12:42 EST, 13 November 2026 | Updated: 15:09 EST, 13 November 2026.

Germany manager Jurgen Klopp insists midfielder Felix Nmecha will not repeat a controversial goal celebration after opposition from supporters.

Nmecha, a Christian player for Borussia Dortmund, was criticised last weekend for celebrating scoring by lowering an imaginary crown from his head onto the pitch.

Sources indicate that the celebration - called 'The King's Return' - was popularised by an evangelical network of footballers called Ballers in God, which counts prominent Premier League players among its members. It is supposed to represent the idea of submission to God.

Recent findings suggest that but an investigation by German outlets found that the campaign website for 'The King's Return' linked to a chat service run by an organisation called Groundwire, where counsellors shared anti-homosexual views and described abortion as 'Satan's Strategy'. Daily Mail Sport encountered similar views when consulting the service.

Nmecha has maintained that his message was one of love, but after a huge outcry in Germany - and talks with Klopp and national team sporting director Rudi Voller - he will not adopt the celebration again.

Klopp mentioned: 'It was a significant ⁠matter. I saw Felix score two great goals and saw the celebration and then the gesture. I thought nothing of it at the time. But then it all kicked off.

Felix Nmecha has vowed not to repeat his 'King's Return' celebration after a huge outcry.

He was called into a meeting with Jurgen Klopp and Germany's sporting director Rudi Voller for the celebration which is connected with evangelical Christian group Ballers in God.

'As the controversy escalated, I started looking into the details of the subject and trying to form a clear picture of it.

'I have known Felix Nmecha for a few months, and I can say that he is a very friendly young man, who is warm and open, and always spreads positive energy when he is with us.

It has been revealed that 'I confronted him with all the things you might have confronted him with. He told me that it had nothing to do with that at all, and that he loves all people and does not discriminate against anyone.

'For me ⁠the most vital concern was settled. Then I stated "how do we do it with the goal ⁠celebration?" He will not be celebrating like that.'.

A vocal section of Dortmund fans opposed the club signing Nmecha from Wolfsburg in 2023 after he had shared anti-homosexual and anti-transgender posts.

Ballers in God was founded in 2015 by former Tottenham midfielder John Bostock and brings together a wide range of Christian players from across the pyramid with weekly sessions.

While the organisation does not hold an explicit stance on LGBTQ+ concerns, their Instagram account did celebrate the end of the Rainbow Laces campaign in the Premier League last year.

In response to the Nmecha story, they wrote: 'We are encouraged by player-led movements such as The King's Return, where footballers themselves take the initiative to express their faith in Jesus.

Klopp indicates Nmecha told him he 'loves all people and does not discriminate against anyone'.

'Our desire is not only to share our hope, but to demonstrate love and respect towards everyone, including those who do not share our beliefs.

'Our focus has always been, and will always be, to point people to Jesus with grace and love.'.

Nmecha noted: 'My message has never been about promoting intolerance, discrimination, or hate in any form.'.

Back at Dortmund, Nmecha, 26, still faces scrutiny. A supporters' group claimed that his celebration clashed with club values and he has been reprimanded by senior figures.

The club's president, Hans-Joachim Watzke, said: 'The fan department has every right to start a discussion like this. I was at their annual general meeting on Monday. It was clear that those who were bothered by parts of his celebration were in a significant majority. So you have to take it seriously and discuss it.

In a recent development, 'If he scores a goal and points his index fingers upwards, everyone knows he wants to thank God. He is also welcome to make the sign of the cross.

Industry observers note that 'But placing the crown on the grass - that is, of course, somewhat linked to Ballers in God. I don’t even want to judge it. When I look at what they stand for, Borussia Dortmund’s code of core values and Ballers in God’s fundamental outlook are not entirely compatible. We don’t want that in our living room.

Sources indicate that 'I told him: "Felix, if you sense that it is dividing the fans, perhaps you will also realise that you shouldn’t do it any more." He wants to think about it. We had a wonderful conversation with him. We had a one-hour video call. That is where we are now, and he will think about it. I hope we can find a sensible solution.

'I like Felix Nmecha very much. We have a very, very good relationship and speak frequently. As a practising Catholic, I am the last person who would want to forbid someone from praying. That is not what this is about at all. It is legitimate, too. The only question we are discussing with him is the second part of his celebration.'.

Villa end goal drought to finally give Emery’s new era lift-off

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Emery always springs into life on European nights and his reconstructed team secured their first win and goals of the season to leave Villa’s 1,700 fans singing in the rain.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Unai Emery is building Aston Villa 2.0 and this was a night when his new kids on the block produced clear signs of lift-off for the next chapter.

Emery always springs into life on European nights and his reconstructed team secured their first win and goals of the season to leave Villa’s 1,700 fans singing in the rain.

Ten summer signings have arrived during a summer of upheaval, which included plenty of high-profile departures after the club’s Europa League triumph in May.

Yet this was an evening that will have further energised Emery on his return to the Champions League.

Nicolas Jackson, Zion Suzuki and João Gomes embody this latest Villa team and all stood out here in Bruges.

Record £65m signing Jackson’s fine individual goal proved to be the winner to settle a chaotic, absorbing contest with the Belgian Pro League champions.

Jackson adds a third for Aston Villa after Sommer comes rushing out of his box! 😱📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/HZ1x3BkfK0.

Suzuki, the £30m replacement for Emiliano Martínez, has clear presence in goal and he is Villa’s version of former Manchester City goalkeeper Ederson with his wide array of passing.

Gomes was also industrious in midfield to recover from what was a nightmarish debut at Brighton, where he was sent off after 40 minutes.

Despite all the changes to this team, talismanic captain John McGinn remains essential to Villa. He became their all-time leading goalscorer in major European competitions with his 12th goal and led by example again, as he has done so many times.

In a recent development, mcGinn strikes to put Villa ahead in Bruges! 💥📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/FJnuxSwYwo.

There were also hints of a strong defensive partnership developing between Pau Torres and Victor Lindelof, following the sale of Ezri Konsa to Arsenal last month.

“Fantastic, fantastic,” purred Emery at one point in the second half from the technical area, and Villa’s season now appears up and running.

In a recent development, emery noted: “This was another step forward and I am so happy and thankful for this. The old players need to keep our standards high and show everyone this is the only way we can achieve the process and reach our targets.

“It’s very notable to start the Champions League with three points and hopefully this will give us confidence for the league. We are improving and we must work hard – it is the only way.”.

Although Emery has established a reputation as the Europa League king, winning that trophy five times, this competition has proved more difficult to master.

His best run was reaching the semi-finals in the 2021-22 season, when his Villarreal side lost to Liverpool.

It remains a tournament in which he is desperate to make an impression, with Villa returning to Champions League duty here for the first time since their thrilling encounter with Paris St-Germain in April 2025.

Only five of that starting XI from the second leg of the quarter-final remain and one of them, midfielder Amadou Onana, is out until next year after sustaining a serious knee injury at the World Cup with Belgium.

With European heavyweights Barcelona, PSG and Borussia Dortmund to come in the league phase, this always felt like a game Villa probably needed to win.

They had only managed one shot on target so far this season before arriving in this historic city, but scored three goals before half-time.

Their opener came against the run of play in the 11th minute, with McGinn casually finding the corner after a lung-bursting run from Torres. McGinn has overtaken former Villa striker Ollie Watkins at the top of the club’s continental goalscoring charts.

Brugge briefly wobbled but were level eight minutes later when Hugo Vetlesen swept home from 10 yards, capitalising on space in the penalty box.

Industry observers note that vetlesen draws Club Brugge level against Aston Villa! ⚡📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/4ZYwPcMHim.

Villa were back in front less than 160 seconds later, with Gomes teeing up Emiliano Buendía for an easy finish. Gomes was released in the box by a clever backheel from Jackson.

According to recent reports, buendia restores Villa's lead just minutes after Club Brugge's equaliser, and Unai Emery is LOVING it! 🙌📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/h2WGkwkTI1.

Two minutes before half-time Yann Sommer, Club Brugge’s new goalkeeper, then had a severe rush of blood to the head by racing from his goal to almost the halfway line in an attempt to intercept Torres’s long pass.

Jackson edged the ball past him and held off a defender to calmly slot into the empty net. He underlined in many moments why Emery has pursued him for so long, after the pair established a strong rapport at Villarreal.

Villa appeared relatively comfortable in the second half until Aaron Wan-Bissaka was judged to have handled a cross from Joaquin Seys, after referee Sandro Schärer was advised by VAR to review the incident on his TV monitor.

It was a simple decision and Nicolò Tresoldi put away the penalty to stir life back into the home supporters.

Club Brugge are back in it from the penalty spot after Wan-Bissaka's handball! 👀📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/pEanRJvimu.

In a recent development, villa defended resolutely as time began to tick away with Suzuki providing authority in goal. The first Japanese goalkeeper to play in the Champions League also produced a number of routine saves in a nervy finish.

This was a promising night for a newly introduced Villa era.

Full-time scenes in Bruges as Aston Villa get their Champions League campaign off to a winning start! 👏📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/nYwtiQ6Xs7.

Sources indicate that villa are defending with six at the back as midfield and defence merge into one. There are seconds remaining as Suzuki punts the ball up field and there is the final whistle! Villa make a winning start to the 2026-27 Champions League.

Another cross from the right is met, this time, by Tresoldi, but his header has no bite and Suzuki gathers.

In a recent development, torres heads another Siquet cross behind for a corner. Brugge load the box but none of their players are able to get a meaningful touch on the ball before Diakhon slips just as he looks to get a shot away from the left of the box.

Slightly less mature play from Gomes, though. He bundles Vermant over and earns a needless yellow card.

Really mature play by Hemmings. Looking to break away, he simply puts his body between man and ball, inviting the challenge and winning a foul.

Villa are working hard in their compact mid-block and Brugge are struggling to find a way through.

Leko sends on Vermant and Diakhon for Potts and Virgili.

Barkley is one lucky boy. Attempting to play out under pressure, the midfielder gives the ball straight to Virgili, who cannot sort out his feet before offloading to Tresoldi far too late. A big let-off for Villa.

Recent findings suggest that gomes goes close after driving through Brugge’s midfield. He really should, though, have played in a free McGinn at the back post. Moments later Bogarde fires another shot goalwards but Sommer gets to it.

Abraham replaces goalscorer Jackson.

In a recent development, villa have wrestled control away from their opponents. McGinn’s teasing cross evades everyone and Alysson’s cross takes a deflection which goes behind for a corner which is not up to much.

Lee hauls down Hemmings which gives Villa the opportunity to slow the game down. McGinn flights a delivery in from the left but Brugge clear their lines.

The ball comes out to Alysson who jinks in from the right, tiptoeing through a crowd, desperate to get a shot away on his left foot, but Seys does well to track his man and smother the effort.

Vanakan and Velesen and replaced by Tsawa and Lemarechal.

Recent findings suggest that yet another dangerous Siquet cross rains in from the right and here it is taken off Tresoldi’s toes by the tip of Lindelof’s boot. The defender did brilliantly to clear his lines at full stretch.

Recent findings suggest that hemmings burst towards the by-line and his cross trickles across the face of goal. Alysson is waiting at the far post but Seys does well to shield the ball and win a free-kick.

Villa’s best chance at putting this game to bed will come on the counter. And here McGinn plays in Jackson whose one-vs-one effort is stopped by Sommer.

Sources indicate that virgili from the left, Siquet from the right. Threats are coming from both wings and Villa need to get their foot on the ball if they are to take the sting out of Brugge’s attack.

Instead they allow Vetlesen a yard of space and his long-range sighter stings the hands of Suzuki who turns behind for a corner.

Emery switches out Buendia, Kamara and Wan-Bissaka for Alysson, Barkley and Bogarde before the corner is taken, and Suzuki stops the eventual delivery on the line after the ball spun off the post!

Another Virgili cross threatens to carve Villa open but they just about clear their lines. Then it is Siquet who delivers, this time from the right, but his cross just evades Tresoldi and Mechele at the far post. The home fans are invested in this, they believe their side can grab an equaliser...

Villa have got their tails between their legs here. From a position of strength, they have allowed the momentum to swing in the hosts’ favour and it has been largely self-inflicted.

Maatsen has a chance to break free but cannot build a head of steam before he is stymied.

Sources indicate that club Brugge 2 Aston Villa 3 (Tresoldi pen) Suzuki dives to his right early and Tresoldi slides the ball into the opposite side of the net. Just the one goal in it now!

Club Brugge are back in it from the penalty spot after Wan-Bissaka's handball! 👀📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/pEanRJvimu.

It has been revealed that brugge have averted their attention to their right hand side, Siquet and Forbs attacking in tandem. A dangerous cross from Forbs is met by Tresoldi but he cannot get the requisite contact on it. Seys collects the ball on the far side and fires a delivery into Wan-Bissaka and out for a corner. Replays show that it comes off the defenders hand ...and referee Scharer is sent to the screen. He wastes no time at the monitor and awards a spot kick!

Villa do appear pretty comfortable here, despite some frequent pressure from Club Brugge.

Pau Torres has been outstanding so far at the back for Unai Emery’s team.

This is also a night where Emery’s ‘fresh’ Villa are coming of age, with Nicolas Jackson, Zion Suzuki and Joao Gomes also impressive.

Virgili then darts in field from his starting perch on the left. Tresoldi backheels the ball back into his path but Virgili’s effort is snuffed out.

McGinn, sensing Virgili’s growing influence on the half, takes matters into his own hands and leaves one on the Spanish winger, Siquet’s free-kick from deep is aimed at Tresoldi but Suzuki is wise to it and sweeps up.

Brugge are just reminding Villa that they are still there. Virgili is at the heart of things again, combining with Vetlesen who works the ball out to Forbs whose cross is well held by Suzuki.

Villa then spring forward, Hemmings breaching the Brugge box, but Buendia’s eventual effort does not make it through a thicket of legs.

Recent findings suggest that brugge are building with a three-man backline, sending Siquet forward high and wide. They’ve had much of the ball in the opening stages of this half, which is probably part of Villa’s proposal. Emery’s side have settled into an out-of-possession 4-4-2.

Recent findings suggest that vanakan is booked for simulation after going hitting the deck off a challenge from Gomes. There is a knowing smile on the Belgian midfielder’s face which suggests the referee’s convictions were correct.

Industry observers note that we are back under way... Siquet replaces Sabbe at the interval.

According to recent reports, nicolas Jackson is off the mark for Aston Villa. He beat Yann Sommer to the ball, held off a defender and was left with the simplest of finishes to round off a fine first half for Villa. pic.twitter.com/gWx6kUTlOX.

Unai Emery has the new kids on the block but this Aston Villa team are hangin’ tough.

This has been a pretty chaotic first-half on the return of the Champions League but Emery will be satisfied with what he has seen so far. It’s very much a case of step by step for his reshaped team, but they should see this game out now.

In a recent development, it’s been a shocking night for Club Brugge’s upcoming goalkeeper Yann Sommer. He’s just had a serious rush of blood to the head and was punished by Nicolas Jackson, who had an easy task to score Villa’s third goal. Sommer has probably ended his team’s hopes of a result here.

Club Brugge 1 Aston Villa 3 (Jackson) A shocker from Brugge, but in particular Sommer. Jackson races on to a nothing punt over the top by Torres, and the situation appears under control with two defenders in the striker’s orbit, but Sommer comes steaming out and Jackson nudges the ball past him before sliding it home into a vacant net.

Recent findings suggest that jackson adds a third for Aston Villa after Sommer comes rushing out of his box! 😱📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/HZ1x3BkfK0.

A sloppy Torres pass out from the back goes straight to Vetlesen who picks out Forbs first time. The winger unleashes an effort from range but Suzuki makes a smart stop.

There is a shout for a Villa handball as Virgili prods a cross on to Kamara’s body, but his arms are clearly by his side.

Recent findings suggest that villa are presented with a great opportunity to break but the pass in behind for Jackson to gallop on to does not have enough juice and the move breaks down. Jackson does have a sight at goal moments later, but he’s only able to poke the ball wide off a free-kick from the right.

A really sloppy piece bit of play from Vanakan who cedes possession to Jackson and he’s straight into Brugge’s backline. He releases the ball to McGinn but the midfielder’s looping cross is cleared. Brugge need to take better care with the detail on their passes.

Jackson escapes the clutches of his marker on the half-way line with a deft spin and he feeds McGinn whose shot is blocked. The ball is worked to Hemmings after Torres is afforded space once more and a block takes it behind for a corner. Villa go short but the routine comes to nothing.

Maatsen flashes a dangerous delivery across the face of goal but the ball bisects Jackson and Buendia precisely and Brugge are able to clear their lines.

Villa midfielder Joao Gomes is having a productive evening as he aims to recover from that nightmare debut.

He was sent off after 40 minutes of his first Villa appearance in the excruciating 4-0 defeat at Brighton and Hove Albion.

Unai Emery is expecting significant things from the Brazilian midfielder, who departed relegated Wolves for £38m in July.

Industry observers note that wan-Bissaka drives down the right as Villa look for a third, but his cross is overhit and goes off on the far side. The right intent, though.

Club Brugge 1 Aston Villa 2 (Buendia) Jackson holds up the ball expertly before slipping in Gomes. The midfielder bursts into the box, outwitting Vetlesen before cutting the ball back to an onrushing Buendia who clips the ball past Sommer with aplomb. A crazy couple of minutes!

Buendia restores Villa's lead just minutes after Club Brugge's equaliser, and Unai Emery is LOVING it! 🙌📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/h2WGkwkTI1.

Aston Villa are back in the Champions League and in familiar territory with an unfamiliar team.

This will be their third match at the Jan BreydelStadion in less than two years but much has changed with the players that last competed here for Unai Emery.

Two of the goalscorers in the club’s last outing in Bruges were Leon Bailey and Marco Asensio, who are no longer at the club.

Of course, they are not the only players that have left and this is a fresh-look Emery team hoping for lift-off this season.

Villa are the Europa League winners but this could be a tricky evening against the Belgian Pro League champions.

Industry observers note that good evening and welcome to live coverage of Aston Villa’s Champions League opener against Club Brugge. Unai Emery’s side voyage across the Channel to face the Belgian champions having triumphed in last season’s Europa League and finished fourth in the Premier League. The Villa mothership has since sailed into choppy waters, though, with a raft of big-name sales preceding a run of two defeats and a draw in the league. An opening-weekend thrashing by Brighton and Hove Albion proved quite the storm for Emery’s new-look crew.

Morgan Rogers alighted for Chelsea in a deal worth £117m, a record fee for an English player, and goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez followed soon after, while Youri Tielemans moved to Manchester United. Ezri Konsa and Ollie Watkins completed the exodus of leading men with late-August moves to Arsenal and Al-Hilal respectively. To remedy the outgoings, Villa twice broke their transfer record this summer, pipping Newcastle United to the signing of Johan Manzambi (£59.5m) before landing Nicolas Jackson (£65m, including add-ons), and added Taylor Harwood-Bellis and Ibrahim Mbaye on deadline day. Whether they can hit the ground running remains to be seen, but Emery has a task on his hands aligning his new recruits before the scrutiny intensifies.

It has been revealed that although Villa swept aside Brugge 6-1 across two legs in the Champions League quarter-finals two seasons ago, here Blauw-Zwart (Blue-Black) represent a stern test having made the Jan Breydel Stadium a fortress in last year’s tournament. Their only home defeat in the league phase came against Arsenal, with a 3-3 draw against Barcelona backed up by 4-1 and 3-0 victories over Monaco and Marseille respectively. Belgium’s second-most decorated club have won seven of the last 11 league titles and know how to win matches. In Yann Sommer, Ivan Leko has one of world football’s most experienced goalkeepers, who kept the most clean sheets in the 2024-25 edition of the Champions League (seven). Captain Hans Vanakan, Brandon Mechele and Joaquin Seys were part of Rudi Garcia’s Belgium World Cup squad, and German striker Nicolò Tresoldi already has four goals in six matches this term. English midfielder Freddie Potts could also feature, having settled in nicely in West Flanders having moved from West Ham United during the summer.

The earlier 5.45pm kick-off time, means Villa, Brugge, LASK and AEK Athens have the opportunity to top the 36-team league …at least for a couple of hours.

Industry observers note that la preparazione del Boca Juniors alla finale di Copa Sudamericana contro l'Atlético Mineiro è stata interrotta da un imprevisto nella mattinata di oggi. Mentre Rodolfo Arruabarrena stava definendo gli ultimi dettagli in vista della sfida decisiva, la CONMEBOL ha effettuato un controllo antidoping a sorpresa nel ritiro della squadra argentina, modificando il programma previsto.

In a recent development, una delegazione della Confederazione sudamericana si è presentata intorno alle 8 nell'hotel che ospita il Boca a Barranquilla, dando il via alla procedura per la raccolta dei campioni. Dei 33 giocatori convocati per la trasferta, 23 sono stati selezionati tramite sorteggio e sottoposti al controllo. L'iniziativa rientra nei protocolli abituali per le finali delle competizioni internazionali e verrà replicata anche nei confronti dell'Atlético Mineiro. La visita inattesa ha però costretto Arruabarrena a modificare la gestione della giornata: l'allenamento era infatti programmato alle 17.30, lo stesso orario del calcio d'inizio della finale.

Nonostante il particolare primo giorno in Colombia, in casa Boca regna la tranquillità. La squadra è arrivata a Barranquilla senza problemi e Arruabarrena può contare su tutti gli effettivi a disposizione, dopo i timori legati alle condizioni di Lautaro Blanco e Milton Delgado. Il tecnico argentino avrà ora gli ultimi due giorni per sciogliere gli ultimi dubbi sulla formazione titolare. L'unica vera incertezza riguarda Tomás Aranda, che ha però recuperato al meglio e sembra essere in vantaggio su Alan Velasco per completare il tridente offensivo alle spalle di Sebastián Villa e Miguel Merentiel.

According to recent reports, il club ha infatti inserito diversi bonus che permetterebbero al centrocampista di arrivare a sfiorare i 6 milioni di euro a stagione. Una soluzione con la quale l’Inter punta a trovare un punto d’incontro tra le proprie esigenze economiche e quelle del calciatore, mantenendo comunque una proposta considerata importante dalla società.

Il dialogo tra le parti proseguirà: nei prossimi giorni sono previsti nuovi contatti per capire se esistano i margini per avvicinarsi ulteriormente a un’intesa.

Industry observers note that la trattativa, dunque, è entrata in una fase più concreta. L’Inter ha fatto la propria mossa, mettendo sul tavolo una proposta economica precisa. Adesso toccherà all’entourage del giocatore turco valutarla e comunicare la propria posizione.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Mauricio Pochettino broke down in tears as he began his farewell as US national team boss, and admitted that he couldn’t turn down the ‘dream’ job of Manchester United head coach.
  • United confirmed that Pochettino has agreed a two-and-a-half-year contract to replace Michael Carrick, and will start work on Wednesday after staying on for a double-header against Haiti.
  • Flanked by US Soccer Federation bosses at the team’s headquarters in Georgia, an emotional Pochettino wiped away tears as he thanked the players and staff.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By CHRIS WHEELER, NORTHERN SPORTS WRITER.

Updated: 15:20 EST, 13 November 2026.

Mauricio Pochettino broke down in tears as he began his farewell as US national team boss, and admitted that he couldn’t turn down the ‘dream’ job of Manchester United head coach.

United confirmed that Pochettino has agreed a two-and-a-half-year contract to replace Michael Carrick, and will start work on Wednesday after staying on for a double-header against Haiti.

Flanked by US Soccer Federation bosses at the team’s headquarters in Georgia, an emotional Pochettino wiped away tears as he thanked the players and staff.

‘I haven't prepared a speech, I'm talking with my heart,’ he said. ‘It's difficult for me to talk now because I am a very emotional guy.

‘When these moments arrive, it is always tough. Normally it is the opposite – you have been sacked! You cry because you want to stay.

‘I think it was one of the most difficult decisions of our career, but you have to move forward.

Mauricio Pochettino broke down in tears as he began his farewell as US national team boss.

Pochettino spoke at a USMNT press conference after his move to Man United was confirmed.

It has been revealed that ‘Not too many opportunities can happen in your career with a side like Manchester United. That is difficult to turn down when it arrives.

‘In some part it’s a very sad decision, in another part we are professional and we are trying to make our dreams come true. We are excited for that step forward.'.

The 54-year-old Argentine revealed that United first made contact on Sunday after a 4-4 draw in Carrick’s final game left the club in the relegation zone.

United are paying US Soccer more than £10million in compensation to buy Pochettino and his backroom staff out of their contracts, and have allowed him to stay in charge for two more matches.

‘I never remarked I wanted to go back in the Premier League,’ said the former Tottenham, Chelsea and Southampton boss, whose first game in charge of United will be against Liverpool at Anfield a week on Sunday.

Recent findings suggest that ‘All of this was so quick because we arrived here last Friday and on Sunday afternoon this type of situation started to appear. There was some contact. When things became bigger, they are very sensitive.

‘We were very transparent with the federation and they understand the situation. The decision between US Soccer and Man United to agree to continue for these two games will not change our commitment.

‘That decision was between the three parties but, of course if Man United agreed different terms, I need to respect that.’.

Pochettino, who will oversee his side's Concacaf Nations League quarter-final tie against Haiti over the next week, insisted it was the 'most difficult decision' to leave the USMNT.

Meanwhile, Carrick issued a statement following his sacking on Thursday after 10 months in charge.

Posting on social media, he stated: ‘I’ve had the immense privilege of leading Manchester United, the football club that I love.

‘There are very few who get to live that and feel it, and for that I’m incredibly grateful.

‘I want to say a big thank-you to the supporters. I must say, you are a special, rare breed.

‘I know we’ve not had the results lately, but you’ve shown me nothing but love and support in times when the easiest thing, and what most end up doing, would be to turn the other way.

‘That’s what makes you who you are. That’s why I fell in love with this club all those years ago.’.

(ANSA) - ROMA, 19 NOV - Allarme-infortuni rientrato nel Frosinone in vista della gara di domenica a San Siro contro il Milan. Il tecnico Max Alvini ha riabbracciato Terzic, Calvani e Cichella che si erano fermati per problemi fisici tanto da dover rinunciare agli impegni con la Serbia e l'Under 21. Il trio ha recuperato e sarà a disposizione per l'attesa partita alla Scala del calcio. A questo punto saranno indisponibili i lungodegenti Grillistch e Raimondo, oltre allo squalificato Bracaglia. Molto importante il recupero di Terzic, rimasto l'unico terzino sinistro disponibile tenendo presente l'assenza di Bracaglia. Il serbo quindi dovrebbe giocare la sua seconda partita dall'inizio. Finora ha collezionato 5 presenze con 1 gol, tra l'altro decisivo, il definitivo 4-4 in casa dell'Atalanta. Al di là degli aspetti tattici, Terzic regalerebbe un pizzico d'esperienza in più in una partita difficilissima che si giocherà in uno stadio suggestivo come il "Meazza".

Se invece Terzic non darà le giuste garanzie, Alvini dirotterebbe Oyono a sinistra con l'inserimento di Tchato a destra. Soluzione già adottata nel secondo tempo di Cagliari. Per il resto Alvini dovrebbe schierare la formazione-tipo anche se bisognerà tener presente l'incognita-nazionali. Il Frosinone ha avuto 11 giocatori fuori con le rispettive selezioni. "Noi come il Milan dobbiamo essere bravi a gestire la situazione dei nazionali - ha detto il tecnico - Comunque sia è una sfida che vai a giocare contro una grande squadra. Il Frosinone deve cercare di mettere in campo la nostra identità. Siamo consapevoli di quello che ci aspetta". (ANSA).

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il Profeta ricorda il suo sogno di vincere a Roma ed elogia Gattuso, Zaccagni e Frattesi nella squadra capolista.

Hernanes assegna alla Lazio il 15% di possibilità di vincere lo scudetto, pur considerando l’Inter la squadra più forte. Secondo quanto riportato da La Gazzetta dello Sport, L’ex centrocampista, soprannominato «Profeta», si dice emozionato nel vedere i biancocelesti primi in classifica e riconosce nella squadra la mentalità di Gattuso.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Per descriverla, Hernanes sceglie un vino che produce in Piemonte: «La Lazio di Gattuso è come un Grignolino, un rosso che produco sulle colline di Asti e di Monferrato, in Piemonte. Un vino romantico. Quando lo bevi, ti viene da sorridere. E mi capita di farlo ogni volta che guardo questa Lazio, prima in classifica con pieno merito». Produce vino da una decina d’anni e nelle Langhe ha il suo campo base, chiamato «Ca’ del profeta».

Il primato ha sorpreso anche lui: «Non me l’aspettavo, ma s’è creata una bella magia». Alla domanda sul titolo richiama l’impresa del Leicester in Premier League, poi dà una percentuale: «Io dico che la Lazio ha il 15% di portare a casa il campionato. Anche se la più forte resta sempre l’Inter».

It has been revealed that hernanes distingue l’emozione dal tifo: è affezionato anche agli altri club in cui ha giocato, ma ricorda che, al suo arrivo a Roma, dichiarò di voler vincere il campionato. Gli risposero che la Lazio lottava per l’Europa; lui, racconta, combatté quella mentalità. «Sognavo di vincere e di lottare per lo scudetto. Vederla lassù mi emoziona».

Nella squadra Hernanes rivede il carattere dell’allenatore: «Questa Lazio gli somiglia: è come se in campo ci fossero undici Rino. È riuscito a trasmettere la sua mentalità alla squadra. La voglia di azzannare ogni caviglia, lottare su ogni pallone, dare tutto senza risparmiarsi mai. Vedo la sua fame, la sua voglia». Da avversario affrontò Gattuso due volte e dice di averlo sempre stimato per l’onestà e il rispetto con cui giocava.

Tra i biancocelesti cita Zaccagni, che secondo i dati da lui studiati crea più occasioni di chiunque altro, e poi Mandas, Belahyane, Provstgaard, Floriani Mussolini e Frattesi. È soprattutto Frattesi, a suo giudizio, a rispecchiare il calcio di Gattuso: nella corsa fatta contro il Napoli prima del gol Hernanes vede ciò che serve per sognare lo scudetto. A Taylor, ribattezzato «profeta», riconosce intelligenza tattica, senso del gol e qualità tecniche. Considera inoltre l’infortunio di Nuno Tavares un duro colpo: per caratteristiche fisiche e stile di gioco lo ritiene insostituibile.

Recent findings suggest that hernanes non crede che i tifosi tornerebbero allo stadio se a marzo la Lazio fosse ancora in quella posizione. Cita la scaramanzia e il rapporto con il presidente, augurandosi che la situazione si risolva perché la squadra merita uno stadio pieno.

Sources indicate that tra i ricordi biancocelesti sceglie i gol nei derby, la Coppa Italia del 26 maggio e le punizioni segnate con entrambi i piedi. Soprattutto, però, gli è rimasta una frase rivoltagli da un tifoso: «non te ne annà, profe’…». Racconta che, dopo quel pomeriggio a Formello, ricevette circa diecimila messaggi dai laziali e cercò di rispondere a tutti. Per lo scudetto indica ancora l’Inter come favorita e invita a fare attenzione anche alla Roma. Di Nico Paz dice che è più forte di lui: «Un fenomeno».
